limits: Cumulative heap_alloc requests, rounded block words, actual heap_free calls and fresh page capacity; not OS malloc counts, live nodes, lifetimes, maximum live payload or CPU ownership.
Constructor tag is direct source ctr_build heap-call origin. Closure/refcount/array/runtime calls outside ctr_build remain untagged. Untagged exact requested payload is unknown.
Spare reuse is counted separately and returns the original location. Packed and static-image expressions are unchanged/unwrapped and not dynamically counted.
Phase5 includes runtime setup, parse, expansion, emission and teardown outside the checker; five checker phases are source-entry-delimited, not inclusive or exclusive function ownership.
Counters are checked u64 on one native compute thread; instrumentation adds increments, checks, memory and codegen effects. No speed or causal overhead claim.

Local freelist hits include both previously freed blocks and untouched siblings of a fresh page refill; these are supply-path counts, not historical per-location reuse/lifetime counts. Cold/bank refills likewise do not classify individual block histories.

Requested payload means ctr_build exprs.length native word slots (including generated layout slots), not source-level field count. Only direct ctr_build heap calls carry known payload; untagged payload is unknown.

Packed/static expressions retain original compile-time/image semantics and are not dynamically instrumented. Boundary fixture proves their zero tagged heap requests; no invented runtime construction totals.
Clock diagnostic affects native timings; complete elapsed time is not production performance, a speed gain, stable300 proof, native fixedpoint or all285 behavior rerun.
No allocation source-site/FID ownership is inferred. Allocation tag is constructor-origin only; marker FIDs are freshly generated for this W build and apply only to logical phase boundaries.

Instrumentation may change compiler optimization/code placement and cannot certify that every event count equals an uninstrumented binary event stream; these are actual events of the authenticated source-generated diagnostic binary, not synthesized constructor geometry.
